title: docs(site): correct the bare-keyword claimant list in registerCatalogBlocks
body:
Fixes #6442

Comment-only. The `IMPORT ORDER IS CONTRACT` note in
`apps/site/app/components/registerCatalogBlocks.ts` justified the import order with a
bare-keyword claimant list naming two packages that do not claim the key.

## Re-derived, not inherited from the card

Run at repo root on `origin/main` @ `e929c562a`, with the repo's own derivation — the same
one that feeds the CLI whitelist and judges doc snippets:

```
node -e "import('./scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs').then(m=>{
  const {keys}=m.deriveRegistryKeys(process.cwd());
  for (const k of ['chart','calendar','ui:calendar','dashboard','report'])
    console.log(k, '<-', (keys.get(k)||[]).join(' , '));
})"
```

```
chart       <- apps/console/src/preview-gallery.tsx:42 ,
               apps/console/src/register-plugins.ts:71 ,
               packages/plugin-charts/src/index.tsx:88
calendar    <- apps/console/src/register-plugins.ts:111 ,
               packages/plugin-calendar/src/index.tsx:303
ui:calendar <- packages/components/src/renderers/form/calendar.tsx:13
dashboard   <- apps/console/src/preview-gallery.tsx:36 ,
               apps/console/src/register-plugins.ts:65 ,
               packages/plugin-dashboard/src/index.tsx:79
report      <- apps/console/src/register-plugins.ts:135 ,
               packages/plugin-report/src/index.tsx:75
```

Counters for that run: `{"sourceFiles":136,"callSites":240,"resolved":235,"open":2,"indirect":133}`,
`findings: 0` — and the same call returned 0 sites for a key nothing registers
(`definitely-not-a-registered-key-6442`), so a zero is a measurement here and not a broken
read.

**Bare `chart` has one package claimant, `plugin-charts`.** `plugin-dashboard` registers
`dashboard`, `dashboard-grid`, `metric`, `metric-card`, `object-data-table`,
`object-metric`, `object-pivot` and `pivot`; `plugin-report` registers `report`,
`spec-report` and `report-viewer`. Neither registers `chart` at all. The two
`apps/console` sites that also hold the key are `registerLazy('chart', () =>
import('@object-ui/plugin-charts'), …)` — stubs of the very package that claims it, and
`Registry.register` drops them unconditionally once a real component lands
(`packages/core/src/registry/Registry.ts:270-271`, outside the `skipFallback` branch). A
stub is a placeholder, not a competing claimant.

**The `calendar` half, re-confirmed with the same read, needed the same correction.** The
card had not checked it in depth. Bare `calendar` also has one package claimant,
`plugin-calendar` (`src/index.tsx:303`, `namespace: 'view'`, no `skipFallback`, so it takes
the bare fallback). `@object-ui/components` registers the date-picker primitive at
`renderers/form/calendar.tsx:13` with **`skipFallback: true`** and says why in place:
"`calendar` collides with the plugin-calendar full CRUD calendar VIEW, which owns the bare
`type: 'calendar'` schema keyword". It therefore never enters the bare keyword — that is
settled at the registration site, not by import order.

So the sentence's opening claim was the thing that was actually false. Measured across the
whole workspace, exactly one bare key is claimed by two distinct packages — `page-header`
(`layout`, `components`) — and neither is among the thirteen packages this file imports.
The note now states the mechanism (last registration of a bare keyword wins), the measured
fact that nothing in this list contests one today, and why the order stays fixed anyway.

## Scope

Per the triage ruling, no derivation pin and no generated sentence: the two render pins the
comment names already guard the list, and the smallest true comment wins. No test was added
to justify the PR — a comment-only diff plus a changeset is the whole shape.

**No public surface change.** `git diff` restricted to every `**/src/index.ts(x)` returns 0
lines, and 0 files under `packages/` changed at all. The diff is one comment block in
`apps/site` plus one empty-frontmatter changeset (the repo's first-class "no release"
declaration — `check-changeset-presence` confirms none was owed).

`pnpm --filter @object-ui/site run type-check` exit 0 (`fumadocs-mdx && next typegen && tsc
--noEmit`) — after `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/site^...' build`, because a fresh worktree's
unbuilt `dist/*.d.ts` produces a `TS2882` false red that has nothing to do with this diff.

### Lint, narrowed and measured

`pnpm lint` is `turbo run lint` (each package lints itself). Two scopes were run with
eslint's own `--format json`:

- `@object-ui/site` (`eslint .`): **32 files** selected by eslint's config, exit 0, 0
  errors / 7 pre-existing warnings. The edited file is in that set at 0 errors, 0 warnings.
- root scope (`lint:root`): **206 files**, exit 0, 0 errors / 28 pre-existing warnings. **0
  `.md` files and 0 `.changeset/` files** are in any eslint population, so the changeset
  cannot move a lint verdict.

Nothing outside those sets can move: `eslint.config.js` extends
`tseslint.configs.recommended`, not `recommendedTypeChecked`, and declares no
`parserOptions.project` or `projectService` anywhere — linting is not type-aware. All seven
custom rules in `eslint-rules/` were grepped for `readFileSync` / `readdirSync` / `fs`
imports and do none, so every verdict is a pure function of that file's own text plus the
config. This diff adds one `.ts` file to that computation and one `.md` file that eslint
does not select.
